en.<p class=\"eyebrow\">Small Bearing Units:
Small Bearing Units

Small Bearing Units (USCP/USBP/USAP, USCFL/USBFL/USAFL)

Miniature bearing units specialized for small shaft diameters (10-30mm). Supplied in pillow block types (USCP ball-bearing type · USBP UC-bearing type · USAP UC-bearing eccentric-collar type) and flanged types (USCFL · USBFL · USAFL).

* USCP·USBP·USAP (and USCFL·USBFL·USAFL) differ only in their internal bearing (ball/UC/UC+eccentric collar), while the external housing dimensions are completely identical; even in our official specification sheet original, the housing dimensions appear only once per group, in the "P-000 to P-006" and "FL-000 to FL-006" tables. The model number column in the tables below lists all three names together — it is not that there are fewer specifications per bore size, but that there were only two housing specification tables to begin with.

You can search by entering just part of the model number or a dimension.

en.내부 베어링의 형번과 외경(D)은 JIB(제일베어링공업) 정식 카탈로그의: The model numbers and outer diameters (D) of the internal bearings are based on the "2.4 Clean Series" specification table (E01) of the official JIB (Jeil Bearing Industrial) catalog — the housing's registered bore (d1) was used as the outer-diameter reference value. Since USCP·USBP·USAP share the same housing (P-000 to 006), all three methods have the same outer diameter for a given bore size. Detailed dimensions such as bearing width (B) are only supplied as part of the complete unit and are not separately published, so please inquire.
